requestBody.query: How to find apps like Crave or Netflix on Fibe TV?

200.answer: To locate apps such as Crave and Netflix on Fibe TV, press the Interactive TV or Apps button on your remote. Then, scroll sideways and press SELECT. For Netflix, you can also go to channel 311 or 1311.

snippets.text: You can browse stations by genre, see a list of recently played songs, display album cover art, and get detailed information on the artists and songs you're listening to. How do I find apps on Fibe TV?  - collapsed To start using applications on Fibe TV, follow these simple steps: Press the Interactive TV or Apps button, depending on your remote control. Scroll sideways to find the app you want. Press SELECT and follow the onscreen directions. NOTE: Some applications require additional setup steps. To navigate within the Apps tab, use the up/down/left/right/select buttons on your Fibe TV remote control. Is there a cost to use apps on Fibe TV?  - collapsed You get the apps at no extra charge when you subscribe to Fibe TV, but using the app will count towards your Internet usage at the same download and upload rates as using the Internet on your computer. To track and estimate your Internet usage, visit bell.ca/myinternetusage.

snippets.text: To access your apps: Press the Home button on your Fibe TV Voice Remote and select Apps. Or Press the Apps button on your remote. Or Press the Google Assistant button on your remote and say the name of the app you want to launch.
snippets.title: Using Fibe TV apps

snippets.text: For French content: Press your remote's on demand button (or navigate to the On Demand section in the menu), navigate to the French - Crave & more category and select Crave FR. Press your remote's apps button (or navigate to the Apps section in the menu), navigate to the Crave app and select it. The first time you use the Crave app you will need to log in using your MyBell username and password. How to access Crave™ on other devices - expanded The best way to access all your content is through the Fibe TV app available on a variety of devices. To locate the Crave content in the Fibe TV app: Log in to the app using your MyBell username and password. Select Menu (in the upper left corner) to open the side navigation panel. Select On Demand Select the Crave logo in either in the English or French section depending on the language desired. Don't have a username?
